correctness.rationale: The Ewens exponential cycle index A_L(z)=exp(theta sum_(j<=L)z^j/j) gives a_(n-s)=g_(n-s)-theta sum_(j=0 to r-s-1)g_j/(n-s-j), since n>=2r+4 precludes two forbidden cycles. Marking a 1-cycle, a 2-cycle, and both yields Cov=theta^2(a_n a_(n-3)-a_(n-1)a_(n-2))/(2a_n^2). The asymptotic relative removed mass theta Gamma(theta)n^(-theta)G_(r-s-1) has determinant linear coefficient -theta Gamma(theta)n^(-theta)(g_(r-1)-g_(r-3)); baseline covariance theta^2(1-theta)n^-2; the theta=2 and theta>2 limits follow. At theta=1 the leading perturbation cancels for r>=3, and the exact harmonic-sum determinant yields n^3 c->(3-2r)/2 and strict negativity; r=1 and r=2 have n c->-1/2. r=1 also factors exactly with a strictly negative bracket at every n>=3. Independent exact rational evaluation for r=1..4, theta=1/2,1,3/2,2,3 and admissible n, including 100, corroborated signs. Fixed-r and theta hypotheses were respected throughout.
